brand_identity.theme_strategy: Light theme is primary. A premium corporate marketing site needs trust, high legibility, and cleanliness. We will use a warm off-white (stone) background with deep navy text, and gold/brass accents.

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, featured numbers. Use italic display accents for emphasis. Tracking tight for larger sizes.

body.usage: Body text, small caps labels, UI elements.

visual_enhancers.borders: Hairline dividers, 1px borders with low opacity for separation.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Extremely subtle, diffuse ambient shadows. Avoid heavy uniform drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp, precise corners (rounded-none). Flat understated cards.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous white space. 2-3x typical spacing (e.g., py-24, gap-16).
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React only. Stroke width 1.5, simple and elegant. NO EMOJIS anywhere.

layouts.editorial: Asymmetric editorial layouts. Combine large imagery with offset text blocks.
layouts.bento_grid: Use high density grids for product listings and data. E.g., grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3.
layouts.containers: Max width max-w-7xl with generous horizontal padding (px-6 md:px-12).
layouts.admin_dashboard: Clean, dense, utilitarian. Sidebar navigation with top header. Contrasts with the airy marketing site by utilizing more functional space.

components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none), full solid for primary (navy background, white text or gold background), keyline/outline for secondary. Add group-hover arrow micro-interactions.
components.cards: Flat, background #FFFFFF, sharp corners, 1px border. Soft hover state: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and soft shadow.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. Sharp corners, clean borders, minimal focus rings.
components.navigation: Solid background or heavy glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90) with sharp bottom border. Sticky on scroll. Must include 'Request a Quote' CTA.
components.sticky_action_bar: Mobile only. Fixed bottom bar with WhatsApp and Request Quote buttons.
components.floating_whatsapp: Fixed position bottom right floating button for easy contact.

motion.scroll: Smooth scroll reveals using Framer Motion (fade up, slow duration 0.8s).
motion.interactions: Restrained micro-interactions. Button hover background shifts, image slow zoom on card hover.
motion.loading: Clean, minimal line loaders or text fades.

3d_libraries.map: Use 'react-simple-maps' or 'react-globe.gl' for the interactive Global Reach world map, styled in navy and gold. No heavy 3d unless it serves a purpose.

hero_logistics.description: Cargo ship in port, conveying global logistics and shipping capability.

dubai_office.description: Modern Dubai corporate skyline for About section and credibility.

product_basmati_rice.description: High quality macro of white rice grains.

product_himalayan_salt.description: Pink Himalayan salt and related wellness setup.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has dark gradient overlay (bg-black/40). Navy on Stone has >7:1 contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='request-quote-button').

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make this site feel like a premium, established Dubai trading firm (like a luxury editorial piece combined with a high-end corporate brochure).
Do NOT use emojis anywhere in the UI. Use Lucide-react for all iconography.
Do NOT center align large blocks of text. Left-align for an editorial feel.
Use generous whitespace. Avoid cramped grids.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds on sticky headers. Always use solid or heavily blurred glassmorphism with bottom borders.
For the Admin Dashboard, ensure it is clean, dense, and functional, contrasting with the airy marketing site.
Remember to stick to .js files for React components if .js is standard for the setup.
